description: This file defines the ModuleController class, which manages REST API endpoints related to modules in SuiteCRM. It handles CRUD operations, relationship management, and metadata retrieval for modules within the SuiteCRM v8 API. The class extends an ApiController and includes methods for listing modules, fetching module details, creating, updating, deleting records, managing relationships, and obtaining module metadata like language strings and view layouts.

classes.name: ModuleController
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests for modules in SuiteCRM, extending ApiController and implementing methods for CRUD operations, relationship management, and metadata retrieval within the SuiteCRM v8 REST API.

methods.name: getModulesMetaList
methods.description: Returns a list of available modules with their API links.

methods.name: getModulesMetaMenuModules
methods.description: Retrieves menu modules accessible to the current user for API presentation.

methods.name: getModulesMetaMenuFilters
methods.description: Fetches module filters and grouping structure for UI filtering options.

methods.name: getModulesMetaViewed
methods.description: Provides data about recently viewed modules/items for the current user.

methods.name: getModulesMetaFavorites
methods.description: Retrieves the user's favorite modules/items.

methods.name: getModuleRecords
methods.description: Fetches paginated list of records for a specific module.

methods.name: createModuleRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record in a specified module based on JSON API payload.

methods.name: getModuleRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single record by module name and ID.

methods.name: updateModuleRecord
methods.description: Updates an existing module record based on JSON API payload.

methods.name: deleteModuleRecord
methods.description: Marks a module record as deleted.

methods.name: getModuleMetaLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves language strings for a specific module.

methods.name: getApplicationMetaLanguages
methods.description: Provides language options available within the app.

methods.name: getModuleMetaAttributes
methods.description: Fetches attribute metadata (field definitions) for a module.

methods.name: getModuleMetaFields
methods.description: Alias for getModuleMetaAttributes.

methods.name: getModuleMetaMenu
methods.description: Retrieves menu layout for a module.

methods.name: getModuleRecordsViewed
methods.description: Gets a list of recently viewed records for a module.

methods.name: getModuleFavorites
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's favorites for a module.

methods.name: getModuleMetaLayout
methods.description: Returns layout/view definition for a module's specific view.

methods.name: getModuleRelationship
methods.description: Fetches relationship data for a module record.

methods.name: createModuleRelationship
methods.description: Creates or adds links in a relationship for a record.

methods.name: updateModuleRelationship
methods.description: Replaces related items or links in a relationship.

methods.name: deleteModuleRelationship
methods.description: Removes links from a relationship of a record.
